Repeating the two-register GL3 census or a covered three-register length without changing a hypothesis; a formal group-algebra word without native conversion is a partial result.

actual_scope: Prove a sharp all-width joint-image bound for complete binary noncoordinate rank-one-idempotent pools in three-dimensional zero-edge pattern spaces; combine with credited edge-quotient bounds.
scope_change_reason: The lead assigned the exact unresolved zero-edge case from #5921 and #6782 after canonical landscape and overlap review. This is structural alphabet reduction before a word search, not another expansion of an already-excluded three-register word family.
bottleneck_link: Three relation dimensions can lead to three-dimensional binary pattern spaces under the exact inherited word hypotheses. The new sharp bound reduces the missing zero-edge joint-image case from seven to four and closes the universal rank-three total-image maximum at six; it does not establish paid-rank savings or supplier admission.
stop_rule: Stop once an all-width proof and attaining complete pool are obtained and independently reviewed, or after the assigned research cutoff. Finite corroboration exhausts widths 3 and 4 spaces generated by realized nonedge patterns, all five-point subsets of F2^3, and literal witness completions up to width 6; no stochastic search or time-based early truncation.
evidence: PROOF.md proves the sharp no-edge bound four and universal rank-three bound six. verify.py checks exact fibers at widths 1..7, all 21 Fano five-point sets, four complete fixtures, a defined finite census and nine negative controls. RESULT.json records the replay.
